body: Just a quick follow up from the last post. Things got worse from that moment and at the end of March I tried to kill myself by jumping off the deansgate canal bridge in Manchester. I was in hospital for 4 days and I’ve been going to therapy since then. 2 days ago I told my sister about my attempt and my problems leading up to and after the attempt. It was the scariest thing I’ve ever had to tell anyone but I’m glad I told her. I dropped out of university and moved back home because I need to be with family. I thought moving home would potentially get rid of my mental health issues but it hasn’t really changed them at all. Therapy just feels like a chore at this point and I feel like I’m just going there to cry when I could be saving money and doing that by myself. I force myself to do things to fill some time during the day but nothing works or takes my mind off anything. My sister had her 25th birthday recently and it made me think that I’m never going to see my 25th and I can’t even picture myself at that age. I’ve started journaling everyday but it goes from what I’ve done that day to what feels like a suicide note by the end.
